semantics.campaigns: independent campaigns; attempts correlated and excluded from single-run completion estimates
semantics.time: timeouts remain censored; successful completion time conditional on success
semantics.gate_budget: finite environmental released-recovery time, consumed even at stamina cap; not a character capacity. Recovery episodes include capped intervals. Positive reserve does not prove safe retreat
semantics.physics: source-derived test instrumentation; instrumentation metadata overrides inherited generic controller description
semantics.proof: policy failure and finite input search failure never prove physical impossibility
semantics.future_nodes: 140-node eligibility and prestige are design only; measured progression is current actual cumulative XP
